newsitem.title: USA: Clinton to meet Democrats on budget pact - Daschle.
newsitem.headline: Clinton to meet Democrats on budget pact - Daschle.

text.p: President Clinton will meet Democrat lawmakers on Friday afternoon in Baltimore to discuss the proposed budget agreement, Senate Minority Leader Tom Daschle said Thursday.

Daschle said Senate Democrats were interested in further details about the size and structure of proposed tax cuts and wanted to make sure any agreement adequately protected programs that they supported.
"Another big detail," he said, would be revenue and spending in the so-called "out years," the last half of the transition to a balanced budget.
"If years six to 10 explode, we aren't going to be really interested," Daschle said.
